messages:
yuki: Heads-up — during Mira v1 int8 bring-up I repro a detok / BLEU regression specific to Canto-style emoji + ZWJ sequences and some RTL punctuation mirroring when paired with shortctx. Small sample below.

anna: omg can you paste the sample outputs? :eyes:

yuki: input: "佢話👍‍❤️‍🔥好正" (Cantonese + emoji zwj chain)
 reference detok: "佢話 👍❤️🔥 好正"
 mira-int32 detok: "佢話 👍‍❤️‍🔥 好正"  (fine)
 mira-int8 detok: "佢話 👍好正"  (ZWJ chain collapsed, emoji order lost)

liang: that's weird — looks like tokenizer detokenization differs post-quant. Do we have token IDs before/after?

yuki: grabbing token ids now, but quick diff shows multiple tokens collapsed into single unknown token around the ZWJ cluster on int8 kernels.

kevin: could be the fused kernel handling of multi-codepoint graphemes. Any change in tokenizer vocab or merge rules?

eva: BLEU on our cantonese test set: baseline fp16=34.2, mira-int32=33.9, mira-int8=31.8 (big drop concentrated on lines with emoji/ZWJ). I pushed a short eval dashboard: https://ci.redwood/internals/mira-quant/cantonese-zwj (private).

anna: can we repro with a minimal script? paste command we can run in CI.

yuki: run this locally:
```
python ci/evals/run_detok_check.py --model mira_v1 --quant int8 --subset cantonese_emoji --max-samples 200
```
returns mismatched detok counts: int8 18/200 vs int32 4/200.

liang: I suspect our kv-cache concat path or BPE decoder path uses an SSE optimization that mis-handles combining state for codepoints > 0xFFFF under int8 simd path. I'll try bypassing the fused kernel.

kevin: @ops-bot can we spin a canary with the int8 runtime un-fused (flag: --no-fused-detok) for Mira v1?

ops-bot: Deploy request queued: canary mira-v1 int8 un-fused detok -> env=staging-ml-2. ETA ~18m. :white_check_mark:

eva: also saw a separate small RTL issue: strings with Arabic parentheses + shortctx got mirrored brackets on int8 only in chat-mode sampling. Example in ticket. Might be same root (kernels handling multi-codepoint clusters).

anna: good triage. Liang, Kevin, can you coordinate on kernel + tokenizer changes and add a unit test for ZWJ emoji chains? Put failure cases under ci/testcases/locale/zwj_emoji.txt

liang: on it, will open PR with reproducer and a patch to fallback to scalar detok for multi-codepoint graphemes.

yuki: thanks — I'll rerun the full cantonese suite after the canary lands. :pray:

kevin: if fallback fixes it we should consider a perf-aware toggle (preferring fused except for flagged locales). Add opt-in via model config.

anna: perfect. Keep notes in the incident thread and ping if CI shows regression gone.

ops-bot: Canary finished: staging-ml-2 -> mira-v1 int8 (no-fused-detok) reports detok mismatch down to 5/200.

yuki: great, looks promising. Scheduling a brief sync later to plan rollout for dedicated clusters.
